Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <Pine.SUN.3.91.95082...@winnie.freenet.mb.ca>,


The "+1 intercept' on the Sport Bike is (wrongfully, IMHO) ruled to be
optional. The is the only example of optional intercept. The idea
is that since weapons are inherently optional, that all equipment is
optional.

The "Optional Press once per Turn" on the Hawg is optional (correctly
ruled, due to card text and the nature of presses, IMHO).
--

If not Conquer the Beast, then definately Trap. It says that combat
automatically has a press to continue combat, for three rounds past the last
card being played. Of course, if you have another press, you can cancel out
the trap's press.. but usually a person that throws down a trap card
typically has presses of his own (to continue combat).

Joseph.

: it's not specifically stated as optional, it just HAS to be. Where's the
: logic of "Well, you've got a Harley now so you have to keep flinging

There was a DTR a while ago stating that using equipment is always
optional, while "using" retainers never is.
So, you might use your Hawg or not, but your Murder of Crows, e.g.,
will do their damage. Even if your acting minion dodges, btw.

Martin
